Gardner Policy Institute's College Age Population projection to project college enrollment trends into the Horizon year. author: - name: Pukar Bhandari email: pukar.bhandari@wfrc.utah.gov affiliation: - name: Wasatch Front Regional Council url: "https://wfrc.utah.gov/" date: "2026-02-11" --- # Environment Setup ## Import Standard Libraries ::: {#561a9c83 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd ``` ::: from plotly.graph_objs.table import header # Load Data ## Enrollment Data ### Utah System of Higer Education ### Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System ::: {#e869ea2b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Output from 5-CollegeEnrollmentIPEDS.qmd df_enroll_ipeds = pd.read_csv("intermediate/Fall_Enrollment_1997_2023.csv") ``` ::: ### 2019 Regional Transportation Planning Excel ::: {#170c3bec .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Following data is from 2019 RTP, the original source cannot be traced df_enroll_rtp19 = pd.DataFrame( { "Year": [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999], "UOFU": [24311, 25581, 25868, 25982, 25645, 26810, 26079, 25895, 25018, 25781], "WSU": [13449, 14495, 14993, 14447, 14230, 13996, 13906, 14613, 13900, 14984], "UVU": [7885, 8777, 9623, 10512, 13293, 14040, 14756, 15994, 18174, 20062], "SLCC": [13344, 15972, 17766, 18311, 19440, 20834, 22394, 24307, 19754, 21273], "BYU": [30465, 31101, 31108, 30547, 30413, 30465, 30563, 31249, 32202, 32731], } ) ``` ::: ## College-Age Population ### American Community Survey 1990-2023 ### Forecast: Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute The following data was obtained from: https://d36oiwf74r1rap.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/SchColAgeFS-Dec2022.pdf and converted to excel using https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/online/pdf-to-excel.html tool. ::: {#01cc532b .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Table 1: Utah School-Age and College-Age Population, 2020-2060 # Note: School-age reflects population ages 5 to 17. College-age reflects population ages 18 to 24. # Source: Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute, 2020–2060 Projections df_gpi_state_forecast = ( pd.read_excel( "data/GPI/SchColAgeFS-Dec2022.xlsx", sheet_name="Table 1", header=[51, 52], nrows=41, ) .dropna(axis=1, how="all") .pipe( lambda d: d.set_axis( [ "Year", "Total_Population", "School_Total", "School_Abs_Growth", "School_Growth_Rate", "School_Share", "College_Total", "College_Abs_Growth", "College_Growth_Rate", "College_Share", ], axis=1, ) ) ) # Table 3: College-Age Population with Change by County, 2020 and 2060 # Note: College-age reflects population ages 18 to 24. # Source: Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute, 2020–2060 Projections df_gpi_county_forecast = pd.read_excel( "data/GPI/SchColAgeFS-Dec2022.xlsx", header=129, nrows=30 ).dropna(axis=1, how="all") ``` ::: ::: {#224ba1f3 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Source: https://d36oiwf74r1rap.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Gardner-Policy-Institute-State-and-County-Projections-2025-2065-Data.xlsx # List of target counties for the query wftdm_counties = [ "Box Elder County", "Weber County", "Davis County", "Salt Lake County", "Utah County", ] df_gpi_projections = pd.read_excel( "data/GPI/Gardner-Policy-Institute-State-and-County-Projections-2025-2065-Data.xlsx", sheet_name="Demographic Detail", header=3, nrows=1230, ).query("Geography in @wftdm_counties")[["Geography", "Year", "Population Ages 18-24"]] ( df_gpi_projections.pivot( index="Year", columns="Geography", values="Population Ages 18-24" ) .rename_axis(None, axis=1) # Removes the "Geography" label from the columns .reset_index() # Moves 'Year' from index to the first column ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ```{=html}
